title: Palindrome Rearrangement Queries
sourceKind: mirror pages and a repository commit (official page not fetched)
summary: Given an even-length string s and queries [a,b,c,d]: rearrange s[a..b] (left half) and s[c..d] (right half) for each query independently; report whether s can become a palindrome.
officialConstraints: Length up to 10^5, up to 10^5 queries, lowercase letters; left range inside the first half, right range inside the second half (mirror source, not the official page).
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts length 2 to 50 and up to 20 queries. Examples and constraints come from a mirror, not from leetcode.com directly.
